Australian Police Mistake Doll for Body

Australian police took 20 hours to identify a lifelike doll found in a suitcase as not being a human body. The discovery led to the initiation of a homicide investigation, which was later called off once the doll was identified. The doll was found in a suitcase in Oallen, prompting an immediate response from law enforcement. The investigation was halted after it was determined that the 'body' was actually a realistic doll. The incident highlights the challenges faced by law enforcement in quickly and accurately assessing situations. The police's initial response was based on the appearance of the doll, which was mistaken for a human corpse.
